about: Page-level ground truth for the header time-signature reader, widening
benchmarks/omr-timesig-2026-08/sweep_time_signatures.py from 5 sources to 11.
Every `expected` entry is per SYSTEM, in top-to-bottom order, and was hand-read
off a render of the page itself (pdftoppm at 200-500 dpi, then a left-header
crop) — not recalled from the work. `verified` says how. Where a page is too
degraded to read the glyph outright, the work's own MusicXML `<time symbol=>`
corroborates and that is said so.
The corpus is deliberately half NEGATIVES. A reader that answers more often
looks better on any metric that only counts answers, and the failure this whole
layer exists to stop was a confident WRONG meter, not a silence.
New in 2026-09 and not present in the 08 corpus:
* SEVEN pages that print a real cut-common. The 08 work withheld the cut-C
template saying 'no page in the corpus prints a real cut-C, so there was
nothing to measure the other side of that against'. 15 of the 97 dossier
works open on one; these are the evidence that was missing.
* 4/8 (Dvorak 9 i), which is the ONE meter in the dossier set absent from
the locator's candidate list.
* 3/4 and 6/4, the most and least common digit meters in the dossier set,
neither of which the 08 corpus contained.
* Four publishers the 08 corpus does not have: Breitkopf & Haertel,
N. Simrock, P. Jurgenson, BrucknerAGA.
